project.name: Restaurant marketing website
project.objective: A marketing website for a restaurant to attract new customers

cases.description: Can you change the header font to something bolder?
Please add our Instagram and Facebook links to the footer.
Swap the hero image on the home page for a new photo we're sending over.
Add a short 'our story' paragraph to the About page.
Add three more dishes to the menu page listing.
Make the gallery show 12 photos instead of 6.
Change the site's color scheme from blue to green.
Could you tidy up the spacing between sections on the home page?
We'd like one more round of revisions on the color palette.
Can customers create an account and log in to save their favorite dishes?
We'd like customers to be able to pay a deposit online to book a table.
Add a staff dashboard where our team can update the menu themselves.
Can you build an online ordering system for takeout?
We want a loyalty points system for repeat customers.
Add a table reservation system with real-time availability.
Set up automatic email receipts after online payment.
Build an admin panel to manage orders and inventory.
Our regular customers keep asking if they can order ahead before arriving.
We'd like a blog where we post about new dishes and events.
Turn the contact page into a form that also lets customers request a callback with a preferred time.
Add a search box to the menu page so people can filter by vegetarian dishes.
Make the gallery page let visitors filter photos by category, like interior, food, and events.
Add a downloadable PDF version of the menu on the menu page.
Add a Google Maps embed and directions widget to the contact page.
Add a simple frequently-asked-questions section to the about page.
Can you make the site better for mobile?
Add some interactive stuff to the homepage.
We want it to feel more premium.
Can you add a booking feature?
Add integration with our other systems.
Make the site faster and more modern.
The owner wants the site to 'do more' for the business overall.
